status: DESIGN ONLY; product implementation requires Main GO
owner: Backend/AI design owner; prior requested Sol/high is historical spawn fact, runtime model not independently verified

actual_commands.command: Read-only PowerShell Get-Content and rg for runtime/context/types/storage/routes/provider/request models/existing tests and AGENTS tail

goal: True question-responsive short discussion grounded in current progress and bounded history, rather than rewriting a preset. The local director guides the next useful focus, while the model can address another supported question.

proposed_paths.backend/app/ai/companion.py: New bounded question/context builder, teaching policy, strict reply validator and local public-fact/output guard. No private game-answer or walkthrough imports.
proposed_paths.backend/app/ai/hints.py: Expose a structured local goal through an optional internal as_goal flag on _next_step; existing default tuple/text output remains byte-equivalent. No free Mock behavior change.
proposed_paths.backend/app/ai/runtime.py: For level3.4, dispatch using TurnStart.mode from Store; preset->run_hint, companion->run_companion. Legacy levels retain existing runtime. Provider/auth/budget implementations unchanged.
proposed_paths.backend/app/ai/types.py: Append TurnStart.mode default preset after existing default history; TurnResult public fields unchanged and do not contain trusted mode.
proposed_paths.backend/app/storage/ai.py: Persist trusted behavior_mode in ai_turns; choose callbacks and final branch from stored mode; dedicated limited history; companion final validator; preserve legacy/preset semantics.
proposed_paths.backend/app/api/routes.py: Resolve mode only from validated request selection or actual server DeepSeekProvider instance, pass trusted internal keyword to begin_ai; replay before constructing new provider.
proposed_paths.docs/SPEC.md: Only if separately authorized: append concise companion behavior/privacy/count/history policy; API and snapshot schema unchanged.

mode_authority.migration: Add ai_turns.behavior_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT existing, guarded by PRAGMA table_info; existing historical rows infer old behavior by level and remain replayable. New turns explicitly write preset or companion.
mode_authority.route_resolution: For level3.4, validated explicit provider=mock => preset; explicit provider=deepseek => companion; no header => companion only when actual configured server provider is a DeepSeekProvider instance, otherwise preset. Other levels retain legacy behavior. Do not derive mode from provider_name text on injected runtime, returned usage, trace, model payload or TurnResult.
mode_authority.reservation: begin_ai(..., behavior_mode=server_resolved_mode) validates the trusted internal mode against level, persists it before model execution, and returns matching TurnStart.mode. Store finish reloads durable mode and ignores runtime claims.
mode_authority.replay: Keep existing normalized body digest to preserve old receipts. For new explicit-mode turns, an identical body/ID under a different resolved mode is REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT without model work; old existing-mode completed receipts replay under prior rules. Replays never instantiate a request provider, increase count or append a second history pair.
mode_authority.callbacks: Only snapshot access for companion/preset. Add server-side ai_read/ai_precheck rejection based on durable mode so a faulty injected runtime cannot bypass the readonly wrapper. Legacy modes keep original tool behavior.

local_director.inputs: Current public state only: visible objects/actions, observed IDs, discovered clues, inventory, public devices/puzzles/minigames/progress and open exits.
local_director.not_prompted: Do not send _next_step rendered preset sentences or TEMPLATES prose. Do not send private answers, full stage chain, walkthrough or hidden future contents.
local_director.question_focus: Supply current supported relation topic metadata and relevant known evidence as alternatives to the default director goal. A question about password formatting can discuss the known format even while the default goal is another local preparation step; unknown content gets an honest observation question, not a guessed answer.
local_director.completed_goals: No demands to re-solve completed cabinet/login/final stages; early-room traversal and returning for missing materials remain valid.

provider_protocol.endpoint_and_model: Reuse existing fixed official DeepSeekProvider configuration and canonical budget; no new endpoint/model or credential storage.
provider_protocol.call_limits: One call only, no correction retry, tools=[], tool_choice=none; output cap no greater than existing runtime output_tokens and initially min(existing,600); reuse call/total deadline and measured usage/error handling.
provider_protocol.input: One system teaching/safety policy plus one JSON user context; all user/history/scene data explicitly untrusted. Context contains current sanitized question, minimal current public facts and known related evidence, local structured goal, supported question-focus relations, at most 3 recent accepted question/answer pairs and 3 current-generation legal action summaries.
provider_protocol.context_bounds: Current question retains existing <=2000-character contract; per old question/answer history excerpt <=300 characters; total context <=24576 UTF-8 bytes, dropping oldest history first and non-relevant clues/objects next. Keep evidence records intact or omit them; do not silently change numeric clue text.

output_shape.answer: nonempty natural Chinese short discussion, <=360 characters, normally 2-4 short sentences
output_shape.clue_refs: unique list containing only supplied known clue IDs

provider_protocol.public_result: Map accepted output to existing answer/clue_refs/status=no_suggestion/stop_reason=null/usage with candidate=None. No proposal or mode field added to public response.

history.new_helper_only: Keep existing safe_history semantics for legacy/preset to avoid changing old evaluation behavior. A companion-specific helper queries bounded recent events for this session/current generation.
history.question_source: Join accepted completed companion ai_turn to the matching ai_begin by turn_id and read that event request_json.message, already session-token/API-key redacted by existing path. Do not expose arbitrary raw event/request payloads.
history.filters: Only completed accepted replies, same session and generation, revision <= current; ignore reserved, unknown, failed/stopped turns and duplicate/replay receipts. Include latest 3 pairs in chronological order.
history.actions: Latest 3 committed actions summarized only as tool/target or item/destination IDs, public success message and new known clue IDs. Omit action.arguments, code/login values/sequence/rotation arrays, raw observation text, token/session/turn/event IDs and raw receipts. Current known clues provide factual evidence separately.
history.restore_reset: Both change generation, so history starts empty; do not reconstruct old-generation chat from archives. Device/inventory/statistics restore normally. Reload/process restart can recover same-generation bounded chat from durable events.

final_store_validation.preset: Existing bounded_render(projection, refs) remains the final authority and ignores runtime prose exactly as before.
final_store_validation.companion: After existing shape/usage/stale checks, require no proposal, no reads, and strict companion reply validation. Rebuild the allowed public fact/ID set from current Store projection and apply the same local answer guard again; do not trust runtime-reported mode, evidence claims or trace.
guard_hard_checks: Known unique refs; no tools/proposal/free action fields; answer length and safe text shape.
Normalize NFKC, case, common separators/zero-width characters and common Chinese digit confusions before answer-pattern checks.
Reject complete numeric codes/login values and common spaced/fullwidth/Chinese-digit variants; refuse to echo user-provided solution-like values rather than treating them as discovered facts.
Reject complete device-order lists/symbol orders/internal device-ID arrays and nine-module rotation/path arrays; allow only partial relation guidance and at most one public action recommendation.

Reject references to absent hidden objects/unknown clue names or IDs using a local identifier/name vocabulary comparison. Known clue text and current public stage are the fact boundary; no undiscovered clue contents are supplied to the model.
Reject common false claims of having executed an action or changed a device/door/inventory; only current projection may state accomplished facts.
final_store_validation.failure: Fixed local safe stopped response (MODEL_INVALID_OUTPUT or existing mapped provider/stale code), no model retry and no hint_count change; preserve measured usage if available. Never silently replace a failed natural reply with a preset and claim companion success.
final_store_validation.honest_limit: Format/ID/state checks are deterministic. Natural-language fact grounding, disguised full solutions and semantic action claims cannot be perfectly proven by regex or a single model. Explicit prompt plus conservative local checks and adversarial offline tests reduce risk, not eliminate it. No real quality/safety acceptance without separately approved actual calls.

count_and_compatibility.companion: Each new accepted valid assistance reply increments existing hint_count and revision once, preserving scoring; do not update current_hint_level from companion request.hint_level. Failed/stale/blocked replies and replay do not count.
count_and_compatibility.preset: Existing no-topic early return, levels, local rotation and validated count remain unchanged.
count_and_compatibility.archives: No new game field, snapshot field/schema/version, archive metadata or save behavior. Existing restore validates and restores statistics, then generation change invalidates pending companion turns and clears chat context.
count_and_compatibility.no_topic: Companion is not gated by available_topics alone: a known-evidence question or clarification is possible without a preset topic. Terminal won state may retain a local no-provider response for minimal scope; Main decides this policy before GO.

proposed_independent_QA: Offline fake-provider captures show different questions at the same state receive distinct relevant replies and preserve natural text rather than bounded_render replacement.
Payload allowlist excludes walkthrough/private constants/key/token/raw action arguments/hidden objects; bounded known evidence/history only.
Trusted mode fake-runtime bypass attempts via usage.provider, trace, TurnResult fields, returned proposal/read calls; persisted mode survives Store replacement.
Adversarial raw/encoded/fullwidth/separated/Chinese-digit answers, copied user guesses, unknown refs/object names/hidden clue contents, full device/circuit arrays and false completion claims.
Concurrent revision/reset/archive restore while in flight => stale without count; completed replay and unknown-crash restart do not repeat calls/count.
Accepted count increments once, no hint-level mutation for companion; save/restore/reopen stats and generation-specific history; preset/legacy regressions preserved.
Frontend desktop checks only after stable Main freeze: separate free preset versus companion input and history states. No new mobile feature or real call in this epoch.
unresolved_before_GO: Main approval of exact product ownership paths, terminal-state policy and conservative lexical guard details.
No promise of perfect semantic leak prevention; Main/user must see the documented practical limit.
Actual paid payload/quality evaluation requires a separately concrete approved call and budget; none is authorized/executed by this design.
